name: idea-to-prototype
description: Idea → product spec → UX design → dev prototype, under a run-wide cost ceiling. The budget circuit-breaker aborts the run if the prototype work blows past the cap — the point of the example is the cap, not the shape.

phases.name: spec
phases.description: Turn the raw idea into a crisp product spec.

phases.name: design
phases.description: Design the UX from the spec.

phases.name: prototype
phases.description: Build a working prototype from the spec + design.
